_note: Outcomes-projection SELECTION — the SSOT for WHICH learning outcomes the site surfaces and how each is realized on the landing. This file is deliberately THIN: it does NOT copy outcome prose (that would drift). It declares only (a) the SELECTION policy — which outcomes from the book's outcomes view (book-models/outcomes.json) the site projects — and (b) the per-outcome SITE realization + book-home link, keyed by the outcome's `outcome_id`. The build reads outcomes.json, applies this selection, and renders each outcome's `statement` + `bloom` + `verb`/`obj` STRAIGHT FROM the model — so re-running the outcomes drain re-syncs the site automatically. The drift check (`check_outcomes_site_*` in tests/html.py) joins on `outcome_id` and asserts: (a) every selected id resolves to a real outcome in outcomes.json (no dangling selection), and (b) every book/Part outcome the policy WOULD select is either projected or explicitly excluded here (no silently-dropped core outcome). Lands AUDIT-ONLY-first. Queryable via `catalog.py outcomes-site`.

_selection_policy.note: The site surfaces the BOOK- and PART-level outcomes only (the 'what you'll be able to do' spine), and only the DERIVED/DECLARED ones — NOT the gap-recommended outcomes (those are the author's fill worklist, not yet a promise the site should make). Chapter/section outcomes are book-only detail. This policy is dogfooded by the drift check: any book/part non-gap-recommended outcome in outcomes.json that is neither projected nor listed in `_excluded` is a finding.

_site_home_note: All projected outcomes render inside one landing section id='outcomes-view' ('What you'll be able to do'). Individual outcome rows carry id='outcome-<slug>' derived from the outcome_id, so each is deep-linkable and the drift check can join site->model per row.

_book_home_map._note: book-home link per primary_unit — book-level outcomes point at the book index; a Part outcome points at that Part's first chapter (book/index.html has no per-part anchor). Derived from book-models/outline.json (part -> first chapter slug); regenerate if the book's part->first-chapter mapping changes.
